findings.explanation: Net 90 payment terms are very long and can severely hurt your cash flow.
Net 90 payment terms require you to wait up to 90 days to receive your money, which severely impacts your cash flow.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the agreement. Before I sign, I would like to propose a few minor adjustments: - Regarding the clause "Invoices are payable Net 90.", this payment period is quite long and can impact cash flow, so I propose changing it to: "Invoices are payable Net 30.". - Regarding the clause "Payment period: Net 90", waiting up to 90 days creates cash flow challenges, so I propose changing it to: "Payment period: Net 30". Please let me know if these updates work for you. Best regards,
